sections.description: Neon RavenHawkTech service showcase blocks for WordPress with editable title and style settings. Visit https://ravenhawktech.com for RavenHawkTech.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress and activate it. Open RavenHawkTech → Service Card Grid to configure title and style settings.
sections.changelog:
2.0.3

  • Preserved original grid behavior.
  • Added RavenHawkTech admin grouping.
  • Added editable title and style controls.
  • Added tabbed admin settings layout.
